answer: Gate entry at a single narrow wharf: each new identity posts a bond that unlocks only after months of honest graded work, and newcomers queue for limited berths per epoch. A Sybil farm then sits in the same harbor as everyone else, its capital frozen while rewards arrive slowly. A sudden orchard of sign-ups from one funding trail stands out at the gate, so cloning a hundred fakes costs real time and locked stake, not just spare keys.
